Prevention: Collect infested and dropped fruit every 7 days & bury at least 30cm deep, feed to livestock, use for biogas or kill in a sealed plastic bag in the sun to break life cycle.
Remove weeds & plant litter and destroy by burning or composting.
Don't plant cucurbits within or close to the orchard.
Follow recommended orchard management practices (regular pruning, optimum manuring & fertilization etc.)
Bag the fruit to prevent egg laying by wax paper or oiled newspaper when flower petals drop after fertilization.
Follow quarantine measures strictly (do not take infected citrus fruit where there is no problem of this pest) to prevent entry and spread of pest.
Till the soil under the tree canopies to kill larvae and/or pupae resting inside the soil.

Recognize the field history of pest attacks in the orchard; if there is fruit infestation by maggots, apply prevention measures for next year.
Direct Control: Use para-pheromone lure and kill traps for fruit fly adults.

Use 6 traps/ropani, evenly spaced, and use them at the time of flowering and just before fruit set.

Spray azadirachtin based product (3ml/l water) in the orchard during
May-July in 15 day intervals to deter egg laying.
Metarhizium anisopliae @ 2-3 kg per ha against larvae; incorporate in the soil at the time of peak fruit maturing period (Jan-Feb).
Restrictions: Equipment (PPE) such as globes, masks etc. while mixing and applying chemical insecticides.
